title: Full rerun final selection and confirmation retain the initial model

data.title: Full rerun final selection and confirmation retain the initial model
paragraphs: The complete full-parameter QAT rerun finished all three passes, 884,220 updates and six native development validations. The frozen development decision selected step 442,110, then evaluated that candidate once on confirmation. Confirmation did not pass the numerical gates: CMU Arctic clean WER rose from 5.093% to 5.416%, a 0.323 percentage-point regression exceeding the 0.250-point clean-cohort retention limit. The complete nine-cohort confirmation interval is also undefined because HiFiTTS clean has only one reader. The saved decision retains the unchanged initial tuned model as default, with no promotion, runner-up selection, refit or additional trial.

The final checkpoint at step 884,220 achieved development macro WER 17.500% versus the initial tuned reference's 18.511%, an improvement of 1.010 percentage points. Its saved 95% macro delta interval is [-1.865, -0.174] points (checkpoint minus initial); all retention guards passed. Seven cohorts improved and the two LibriSpeech cohorts regressed. All nine individual cohort intervals include zero. This endpoint was 0.098 points worse on the development macro point estimate than the selected step 442,110; no checkpoint-to-checkpoint superiority interval was measured.

Final-checkpoint development WER, initial to step 884,220 (%), with saved 95% delta intervals in percentage points: AMI 26.825 to 25.035, [-4.901, +0.611]; CHiME-6 76.320 to 71.328, [-11.254, +1.336]; CMU Arctic clean 8.541 to 8.096, [-1.610, +0.624]; Common Voice age 12.286 to 11.961, [-2.226, +1.479]; HiFiTTS clean 7.485 to 7.253, [-0.936, +0.262]; HiFiTTS native 6.464 to 5.247, [-3.908, +0.185]; LibriSpeech clean 5.894 to 6.056, [-0.650, +0.977]; LibriSpeech native 10.269 to 10.448, [-1.077, +1.308]; VOiCES 12.511 to 12.076, [-1.213, +0.434]. Its quiet-speech WER was 32.271% versus 31.823% initially, a 0.448-point regression, with 95% delta interval [-3.951, +5.206]. All 20 silence/noise probes remained empty (zero false-positive clips and zero inserted words).

The six development macro WERs in increasing checkpoint order were 18.066%, 17.805%, 17.402%, 17.684%, 17.639% and 17.500%. Step 147,370 failed CMU Arctic clean retention; the other five met the fixed development gain and retention rules. Selection used equal weighting of the nine cohorts and a minimum 0.200-point improvement, not the final checkpoint's position in the run. Step 442,110 improved development macro WER from 18.511% to 17.402% (1.108 points; saved 95% improvement interval 0.338 to 1.939 points). Six development cohorts improved; Common Voice age, HiFiTTS clean and LibriSpeech clean regressed within their guards.

On the separate confirmation panel of 1,308 views, the selected candidate improved macro WER from 18.698% to 18.148%, a 0.550-point gain. AMI, CHiME-6 and VOiCES improved; CMU Arctic clean, HiFiTTS native and both LibriSpeech cohorts regressed; Common Voice age and HiFiTTS clean tied. The following cohort comparisons use the preserved initial tuned reference, not the fresh pretrained initialization. WER values are percentages; each saved 95% interval measures candidate minus initial in percentage points, so negative changes favor the candidate.

Common Voice age: development 12.286 to 12.368 (95% delta [-1.698, +1.855]); confirmation 11.265 to 11.265 (95% delta [-1.237, +0.910]). HiFiTTS clean: development 7.485 to 7.562 (95% delta [-0.749, +0.656]); confirmation 6.250 to 6.250 (95% delta undefined). HiFiTTS native: development 6.464 to 5.247 (95% delta [-3.251, +0.228]); confirmation 4.568 to 4.731 (95% delta [-0.758, +1.393]).

LibriSpeech clean: development 5.894 to 6.096 (95% delta [-0.591, +1.123]); confirmation 4.633 to 4.792 (95% delta [-0.495, +0.919]). LibriSpeech native: development 10.269 to 10.045 (95% delta [-1.394, +0.754]); confirmation 13.955 to 14.334 (95% delta [-0.903, +1.737]). VOiCES: development 12.511 to 11.758 (95% delta [-1.691, +0.235]); confirmation 9.473 to 8.396 (95% delta [-1.669, -0.396]).

Selected-candidate quiet speech improved from 31.823% to 31.781% WER on development (160 views, 77 sources, 1,004 words; 95% delta [-4.626, +5.243] points) and from 32.587% to 31.033% on confirmation (134 views, 71 sources, 558 words; 95% delta [-4.251, +0.847] points). Both intervals include zero. On each panel, the initial and selected models returned no words on all 20 silence/noise probes: 0/20 false-positive clips and zero inserted words. These small probe sets do not establish behavior under every noise or silence condition.

Confirmation microphone slices show AMI array WER 44.928% to 42.995% and headset 20.718% to 18.923%; CHiME-6 array 83.364% to 79.182% and worn 36.591% to 36.341%. VOiCES clean improved 5.597% to 5.059% and far 15.608% to 12.487%, while close worsened 7.212% to 7.643%. At the selected checkpoint, development CHiME-6 worn WER also worsened 41.606% to 42.336%. These descriptive slices have no separate saved uncertainty interval and are not validation with the product microphone.

Saved uncertainty uses 10,000 paired meeting/session/speaker bootstrap resamples within cohort after averaging microphone views for each source. Development intervals are exploratory and are not adjusted for choosing among six checkpoints. All individual development cohort intervals include zero. Confirmation AMI, CHiME-6 and VOiCES intervals favor improvement, but coverage remains limited: CHiME-6 has three sessions; HiFiTTS native three readers; CMU Arctic four speakers; VOiCES only 20 sources across ten speakers (development: 26 sources, thirteen speakers). HiFiTTS clean confirmation has one reader, so its own interval and the complete nine-cohort macro interval are undefined, not zero uncertainty. No substitute partial macro interval is used. The panels have disjoint groups under the frozen split but reuse previously evaluated populations; there is no fresh independent confirmation.

Training visited all 2,052,751 qualified views once per pass for three passes, totaling 6,158,253 visits across 220,174 distinct source utterances. Final visits/distinct sources were Common Voice 273,369/91,123; AMI 2,048,436/76,795; CHiME-6 3,785,661/51,743; VOiCES 50,787/513. The selected checkpoint had 3,079,489 visits: Common Voice 136,667; AMI 1,024,422; CHiME-6 1,893,013; VOiCES 25,387, with the same 220,174 distinct sources. Repeated passes and microphone views do not add independent utterances. The original objective weights, source balance, reduced quiet-view confidence, quarantine, age filtering and CHiME opening reservations were unchanged. Development and evaluation were excluded from training.

Default native model: C:\Users\amiri\Documents\GitHub\just-peachy\training\whistle_age_robust_v1\whistle.final.cact (SHA256 cd6b10970450112a70f08cbf6416cac04462932be4604bda8f93b758f5b1c337). Preserved experimental candidate: C:\Users\amiri\Documents\GitHub\just-peachy\training\whistle_full_rerun_v1\whistle.experimental.cact, an alias of step 442,110 (SHA256 3e3cd823f1eb7aceda29680a634a0eb3605f1d5bf317052e7f2dbf88ab3611af); full weights are weights.experimental.msgpack (SHA256 0eae99fba67e1fd5e641971b6f92664ef1a45e704d7257432df3cd4c468ead03) in that directory. The terminal step 884,220 export remains separately preserved. Score ID zero refers to the initial tuned reference; whistle.base_zero.cact is the distinct fresh pretrained initialization.

Frozen provenance records Common Voice CC0-1.0, AMI and VOiCES CC-BY-4.0, CHiME-6 CC-BY-SA-4.0 with the user's 23 October license resolution, and Apache-2.0 for the base and runtime. Attribution records are retained. No real product-microphone validation or independent final age test was performed. The saved evidence supports an exploratory transcription gain with a clean-speech retention failure, not replacement of the default model. All declared work for this rerun is complete. The Word revision is checked for publication and OOXML structure; visual layout remains unreviewed because no approved renderer was available and the previously blocked installation was not retried.
